nodes.rationale: MANAGER replaces former Manager, Accountant Manager, and Accountant built-in account types.

nodes.label: Global Sales Read Visibility Only
nodes.rationale: Read visibility does not grant cross-branch mutation; separated from legacy global write scope.

nodes.label: Sales & Cylinder Tracking ERP
nodes.rationale: Next.js 15 / React 19 App Router ERP for branch-scoped gas-cylinder inventory, sales, debt, reconciliation, and audit.

nodes.label: No Privilege Escalation on Role Assignment
nodes.norm_label: no privilege escalation on role assignment

nodes.label: Cloudflare Tunnel Entry Point
nodes.rationale: Public HTTPS via separate cloudflared compose joining docker_shared; routes to sales_nextjs:3000.

nodes.label: Multi-Currency Customer Credit Ambiguity
nodes.rationale: Invoice/debt/price have currency but Customer.creditLimit/creditBalance are single unlabelled amounts; P0 production decision required.

nodes.label: User Mutation Audit Atomicity Gap
nodes.rationale: User row and audit written sequentially due to PrismaPg transaction concern; failure can leave mutation without audit evidence.

nodes.label: Write-Off Approval Policy Gap
nodes.rationale: Mechanics correct but one manager can write off full debt; production may need threshold or second approver.

nodes.label: Single Accounting Currency per Customer
nodes.rationale: Roadmap default: one accounting currency per customer/branch for OMR-first beta; alternative is CustomerCurrencyBalance model.

nodes.rationale: Path: /salesman/new-order

nodes.label: Invoice Debt Settlement Buckets
nodes.rationale: Invoice.paidAmount, debtAmount, writtenOffAmount are separate settlement buckets; DebtPayment is collection/write-off ledger.

nodes.label: Mandatory Branch Isolation
nodes.rationale: Queries filtered by branch must use branchWhere/canAccessBranch from lib/branch-scope.ts.

nodes.label: Prisma.Decimal Money Rule
nodes.rationale: Never use JS float for money; format with formatMoney from lib/money.ts (3-decimal OMR).

nodes.label: MASTERTESTER_ENABLED Feature Flag
nodes.rationale: When true, seeds tester and canonical users and enables /tester; default false in production.

nodes.label: Master Tester Real Impersonation
nodes.rationale: Tester reissues session cookie as canonical test user; not superuser launcher.

nodes.label: Middleware to Server Action Request Flow
nodes.norm_label: middleware to server action request flow
nodes.rationale: Browser -> JWT middleware -> getCurrentUser sessionVersion check -> Server Component -> scoped Server Action -> Prisma transaction -> audit log.

nodes.label: CI Verify Job
nodes.rationale: typecheck, lint max 0 warnings, unit tests tests/*.test.ts, build; e2e excluded for speed.

nodes.label: API Route Self-Guard Rule
nodes.rationale: middleware allows all /api/* through; each route must call getCurrentUser and apply branch/invoice scope before DB access.

nodes.label: Auth Trust Model
nodes.rationale: JWT + route permission map default-deny; session.ts re-validates sessionVersion and isActive; Server Actions repeat scope checks.
